verdict.rationale: The model is officially usable in a first-party coding agent: Grok Build runs on the API and CLI, and community users confirm the CLI works well and that Grok is used inside Cursor. The REST API is also documented as OpenAI-compatible, which lets it slot into existing tooling. However, there is no documented official SDK, plugin or skill for third-party agent frameworks, and OpenAI compatibility is a building block rather than a named integration. Missing for 10: documented first-class SDKs, official plugins or skills for third-party coding agents and agent frameworks (e.g. named framework integrations), and integration guides beyond the first-party CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug the model into coding agents and agent frameworks through documented, official integrations — skills, plugins, or first-class SDK support
